messages:
maya: FYI, onboarding report: our Node quickstart sample is spamming duplicate X-Request-ID fields when auth refresh does a 401->retry. Seen in structured logs and Sentry.
raj: ugh. which SDK version/runtime? any small repro?
maya: sdk-node v0.9.1, local sampleapp. repro is easy: trigger a forced auth fail so client retries. curl I used: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer BAD\" -H \"X-Request-ID: req-742\" http://localhost:8080/generate
```
maya: sampleapp structured log shows attempt 1: request_id=req-742; attempt 2: request_id=req-742, request_id=req-742 (duplicated key in JSON)
sam: that suggests retry code is appending headers instead of replacing/preserving. Python client reuses header refs so not flaky there.
kai: parity bug between runtimes then. Could confuse SRE/CS when debug traces show duplicates.
maya: also, OTEL spans exported to our tracing backend sometimes include both http.request_id and http.request_id_1 after retries — exporter treats them as separate attributes. Looks like redaction rules are applied inconsistently and we end up with placeholders + duplicates.
raj: ordering question: is the OTEL hook running per-attempt or once per high-level request? That changes attribute behaviour.
maya: in node sampleapp we init OTEL after the retry middleware, so each attempt creates its own span and sets attrs. Python quickstart wraps the whole flow in a single span, so no dupes.
raj: action items: (1) change node retry to preserve header object instead of concatenating duplicates, (2) normalize OTEL hook to set request_id once and attach retry_count, (3) add e2e test in sampleapp to assert single X-Request-ID header on outgoing request.
sam: quick patch idea: 
```
// old
options.headers = [...options.headers, ...retryHeaders]
// new
const hdrs = new Headers(options.headers)
retryHeaders.forEach((v,k) => hdrs.set(k,v))
options.headers = hdrs
```
raj: sounds right. I'll open a PR and include unit + sampleapp e2e. I'll also add a small OTEL normalization helper that dedups keys before exporting.
maya: can we add a short note in the sampleapp README / onboarding FAQ so new users know why they might see duplicate request IDs while we roll the fix? customers will open tickets.
kai: yes add docs blurb. Also add the case to SDK parity checklist so we don't regress in other languages.
sam: temporary mitigation: can someone patch Sentry scrubbing to drop keys matching `http.request_id_1` until deploy?
maya: I'll file a ticket for infra to add that scrub rule.
ci-bot: deploy queued for branch maya/telemetry-retry-fix — CI job 912 passed :white_check_mark:
raj: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/7348 — includes header preservation, otel-normalize, sampleapp test.
maya: note for testers: flip sampleapp loglevel to DEBUG to see the duplicate-field printing. INFO/logging often hides the intermediate structure. Took me an hour to track it down.
kai: great work. next steps: PR review -> merge -> patch Sentry rule -> update README + parity matrix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
